name: Select Menu
summary: The dropdown surface that holds selectable options.
description: The popover surface opened from a Select trigger — a bordered, elevated panel with role="listbox" that holds a list of Select Menu Items passed as its content. It comes in three sizes (sm / md / lg) and binds its surface, border, radius, and elevation to the system's semantic tokens.
whenToUse: Present the list of options opened from a Select trigger
Group a set of Select Menu Items into one scrollable, elevated surface
whenNotToUse: A menu of actions or commands — use a Menu, not a listbox
Free-form text entry — use an Input or Textarea

size.sm: Compact — pairs with a small Select trigger.
size.lg: Roomier — pairs with a large Select trigger.

states.default: Open surface holding its items; visibility is controlled by the Select.

dos: Fill it with Select Menu Items and keep them consistently sized
Match the menu size to the Select trigger that opens it
Let long lists scroll rather than overflowing the surface
donts: Don't mix unrelated actions into an option listbox
Don't nest another menu surface inside a single option
Don't hardcode its elevation or radius — they come from tokens

keyboard: Arrow keys move through options; Enter selects
Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger
notes: Carries role="listbox"; its children are role="option"
Selection and active option are exposed via aria-selected and focus
Opened and closed from the Select trigger, which owns the expanded state
